newsitem.title: BERMUDA: Sea Containers sees 97 container revs off.
newsitem.headline: Sea Containers sees 97 container revs off.

text.p: Sea Containers Ltd said Thursday it expects a small reduction in its container unit results for 1997 versus 1996 because of higher interest rates on container debt, soft lease rates and lower use.
The company said the container unit had revenues for the quarter of $44.6 million compared to revenues of $51.8 million for the same period a year ago.

Revenue in the company's other two units rose during the quarter. Ferry, rail and port operations revenues was $154.0 millon compared to $21.8 million, and the leisure opertions revenue was $47.0 million compared to $29.5 million.
The company reported a loss per share for the quarter of $0.13 compared to a loss of $0.34 for the same period a year ago.
